mathematics_and_source_review.requirement: Photons per H and same eliminated source denominator/rates
mathematics_and_source_review.reason: PrimaryPacket.per_h and source rate units establish N in photons/H. The same kappa=c*nH*lower*sigma is used in D=1+d*sum kappa and R=kappa*N. Thus d sum R=Nin-N without an extra nH or duration normalization.

mathematics_and_source_review.requirement: Incoming affine in b, independent of lambda and gas, fixed coefficient family
mathematics_and_source_review.reason: Future source amount is b times the captured rounded dt*SOURCE leaf and fixed ray weights; geometry and COMMON are held fixed. Full and first_half independently start from the same COMMON. The incoming mixed derivative vanishes in the underlying fixed real-source family.

Differentiating J_g U+J_lambda with respect to b gives J_g W+J_gg[U,V]+J_glambda V+J_gb U+J_lambdab. The code uses all four gas indices, lambda slot 4 and birth slot 5 and retains all five terms. The photon sign is applied as -d times the absorption contraction.

mathematics_and_source_review.requirement: Captured heat residual and nonphoto/expansion bookkeeping
mathematics_and_source_review.reason: The nonphoto clone precedes HH, photo and expansion. The same chi_H cancels the HH reaction exactly under ell. Each epsilon is exact(captured heat)+exact(CHI)-exact(E), retaining the source subtraction-rounding defect. B=ell F_nonphoto-2 Hmean w+sum epsilon R follows. The stage-f projection already includes the stored-density normalization difference; no second Jnorm is added.

mathematics_and_source_review.requirement: Uniform and finite same-family FTC and ratio
mathematics_and_source_review.reason: The same C2 branch and one fixed alpha support I_Q=integral_rectangle W_Q. The rectangle area is one. With A=-I_e>0 and T=I_e+I_gamma, I_gamma/A=1+T/A. Both interval ratio expressions and their intersection therefore enclose the same finite ratio. The argument does not integrate a pointwise ratio or mix different source tuples.

mathematics_and_source_review.requirement: Exact rational arithmetic and signed tails
mathematics_and_source_review.reason: All rational interval operations are exact over finite captured binary64 leaves; float conversion is display-only and widened outward. Every stored 7-gradient and 7x7 signed Hessian is read, all 99 rate Jets and 4 nonphoto Jets per stage are retained, and subnormal-width tails are not clipped.
